english.title: Fail notify Environment Agency of location of records of flow, level, volume of inland waters after gauge installation
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the person required to give notice under section 200(1) of the Water Resources Act 1991, failed to give notice to the appropriate agency, namely **(..SPECIFY AGENCY..), stating where the records obtained by means of the gauge were to be kept within one month of the completion of installation of a gauge for measuring and recording the flow, level or volume of inland waters other than discrete waters
english.legislation: Contrary to section 200(2) and (4) of the Water Resources Act 1991.
english.pointstoprove:
